title: This is Pokemon Lostlands - aka FFCCxPBR, a game about adventure.
author: Baphaddon
selftext:
Reposting because the original thread I was sharing from another reddit was taken down.

This is (my demo of) Pokemon Lostlands. It is a game directly inspired by Overlord, King's Field 4, Runescape, Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles, FFTA and World of Warcraft. What this was made for was to test my procedural map generator for the mission board system I planned on implementing in the full game. This is inspired by FFTA's Pub, which I always loved; essentially a slice of what to expect.

Nonetheless, this is a game that has a full, engaging campaign (albeit no story), functional pc storage, a shop, breeding, pokemon center, catching and the things that complete that typical pokemon loop while also offering significant replayability. Easily over 50 hours of gameplay

Let me know if you have any questions
